questions.ask: What name should I use for you: the one that appears on screen and in my notes?
What is the business or brand called?
What is your main handle, and on which platform do you post most?
In one sentence: what do you help people with, and who are they?
What is your accent colour (the one colour used for the key word, the focal element and the glow)?
(saved with the accent colour) the plain word for it: blue, gold, lime
Which font do you use for headlines?
(found on their computer) the bold weight of the main font
(found on their computer) the regular or medium weight of the main font; left unset, the bold is reused
Do you want key words in a second, contrasting font, or the same font in your colour?
(found on their computer) the emphasis font; the shipped Playfair Display Italic if they have no preference
Transcribe with ElevenLabs (recommended, the most accurate word timings) or on this computer (free)?
Where should finished videos go? Next to the raw file in an '- Edit' folder is the default.
questions.default: beside the raw file, in a "<video name> - Edit" folder

questions.ask: Is your raw footage on an external drive? Which one?
Do you have a sound-effects pack (whooshes, pops, clicks)? Tell me the folder.
questions.default: none yet (videos are delivered without sound effects)

questions.ask: Where do you keep the real things I can show on screen: client results, reviews, screenshots?
What do you record with? Tella (a camera track plus a screen track per recording) is the supported default; anything else works if you can give me the two files as camera.mp4 and screen.mp4.
questions.default: Tella: a camera track and a screen track per recording

questions.ask: Where do your raw lesson recordings live? I look there first when you name a video.
What colour is the page of your document on screen? Say a hex code, or leave it and I read the colour from the recording itself.
How short may a full-screen moment be, in seconds? Five is the default; raise it if the switching between document and you feels busy.
Besides your proof folder, are there other folders I should search for real things to show: client work, brand assets, screenshots?

When you name a company, a person, a channel or a website, the illustration is strongest with the real thing. May I fetch real logos, avatars, screenshots and thumbnails from the web? I list every source in my report.
questions.default: yes: real over drawn, every source listed in the report

questions.ask: Is there anything that must never be shown on screen: names, clients, competitors, figures, old offers?
If a recording comes in quiet, should I ask you before raising the voice level, fix it automatically, or never touch it? (Only recordings that measure quiet are ever affected.)
If the voice is raised, to what loudness? The default is gentle: about -19.8 LUFS, natural, nothing else added.
How much light de-noise, in dB, should go with a raise? The boost brings up mic hiss; 6 is light, 0 is none.
When a line really matters, the picture can cut in closer on the creator for a moment (only while full screen). How strong? 112 is clear but gentle.
Graphics can use depth (cards separating towards the viewer, a screenshot at a slight angle). Keep that, or keep everything flat?
Alongside the version with quiet sound effects, deliver a second copy with no sound effects at all?
How far should I go before checking in? Show the plan as a short table, then build and report at the end (default), or stop and ask after the cut, after the plan and after the draft?
questions.default: show the plan as a short table, then run to the end and report
